name: night-shift
description: Runs your queued tasks at a scheduled time, like overnight, and leaves you a report.

allowDirty.title: Allow uncommitted changes
allowDirty.description: Start even when the git working tree has uncommitted changes (or the project is not a git repository). Off keeps the night's work cleanly reviewable with git diff.

maxTasks.title: Tasks per night
maxTasks.description: The most tasks one shift runs (1-50); the rest stay queued for the next one.

taskMinutes.title: Minutes per task
taskMinutes.description: A task still running after this long is stopped and the shift moves on (5-240).
